services.name: League Bowling
services.desc: Welcome to Bowlarama Dieppe, the top choice for bowling enthusiasts in Dieppe, New Brunswick. Whether you're here for a casual game, an exciting birthday celebration, or to join our competitive leagues, our friendly staff and fantastic facilities guarantee a great time. Our arcade alley offers a variety of games for everyone. Don't miss cosmic bowling nights for an extra layer of fun. Book your lane today and strike up some fun at Bowlarama

includes: Use of bowling lanes and equipment
gap: Duration of bowling sessions not stated
blurb: Guests can enjoy bowling games, celebrate birthdays, join competitive leagues, and participate in cosmic bowling events. Facilities include modern bowling lanes and an arcade alley. Bookings are available online with specific policies on cancellations and rescheduling.
extraNote: All online bookings are non-refundable once confirmed · Rescheduling requests must be made at least 24 hours before booking time and are at the discretion of the location manager · Bowlarama reserves the right to reschedule or cancel bookings due to unforeseen circumstances such as power outages or weather-related closures · Payment is required in full at the time of booking · Disruptive behavior or misuse of equipment may result in removal without refund
